created_by: sole root controller before new SHW4/RH4 8/10 predictions and references
floors: Story1 through Story12, X direction only
purpose: An additional declared engineering objective: reduction of the selected-input envelope of each floor's absolute shear peak. Do not replace or relabel previous each-input decisions.
rule: reject if any targetfloor D_upper<Dreq; pass if all D_lower>=Dreq and all widths<=width_max with valid data; otherwise one complete candidate analysis across the listed inputs
baseline_sensitivity: For a unique baseline-controlling input, S_env is that input's own baseline S, not min S across all inputs. Tied baseline input peaks use the maximal force derivative before dividing by P0_env.
controlling_input_uncertainty: List each input with U_e>=max_j L_j as potentially controlling; uncertain controlling identity does not invalidate an effective envelope interval.
other_objective_report: Separately preserve min_e individual relative reductions as the stronger each-input target; it is not generally equal to the envelope reduction.
new_reference_scope: Only SHW4X and RH4X zeta10 need new target solves; reuse exact old8 references after prediction freeze and verify same omega/B/ag/t.
cost_claim: Record new preparation/forecast/bound/reference work; no speedup assumed.
